categories.main_business_segments: Guangzhou Goaland Energy Conservation Tech Co., Ltd. primarily operates in industrial thermal management equipment, focusing on high-power electric power electronic thermal management products and high power density device thermal management products. Their main product lines include DC transmission converter valve pure water cooling equipment, flexible AC transmission thyristor valve pure water cooling equipment, high-power electrical drive inverter pure water cooling equipment, data center liquid cooling products, energy storage liquid cooling products, and engineering operation and maintenance services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in liquid cooling technology using high insulation and high specific heat capacity cooling liquids in closed-loop forced cooling systems. They emphasize customized and modular product designs, advanced manufacturing processes such as ultrasonic cleaning of stainless steel pipes, heat load detection, and proprietary software control systems. Their products integrate thermal management solutions with high efficiency, reliability, and environmental adaptability, supported by extensive patents and participation in national and industry standards formulation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large state-owned enterprises in the power industry, listed companies, and leading internet companies. The company serves industries such as ultra-high voltage DC transmission, flexible AC transmission, high-power electrical drives, data centers, energy storage, scientific research, medical, and communication sectors. Major clients include State Grid, Southern Power Grid, Xi'an XD, XJ Electric, ABB, ByteDance, Alibaba, Tencent, and others.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with significant domestic sales and manufacturing bases, including Guangzhou and Yueyang. It also has emerging international market presence in regions such as the Middle East and Brazil. The company has subsidiaries and operations in the United States and other locations, supporting global sales and service.
categories.supply_chain_position: Guangzhou Goaland operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and integration of thermal management equipment and systems for power electronic devices and data centers. It procures raw materials and components from suppliers and delivers customized solutions directly to end customers, including system integrators and large industrial users.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in full-scenario thermal management technologies, focusing on power electronics, energy storage, data centers, and special industries. R&D efforts include development of advanced liquid cooling systems, intelligent diagnostic platforms, and proprietary control systems. The company actively participates in standard-setting and aims to expand its product portfolio and international market presence, emphasizing green and energy-efficient solutions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of customized and standardized thermal management products and provision of engineering operation and maintenance services. The company follows a direct sales model with long-term technical cooperation and brand demonstration to secure contracts, mainly selling products and integrated solutions to large industrial and power sector clients.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic supplier in the industrial thermal management equipment sector, competing with both domestic and international firms such as ABB and Siemens. It holds a strong market position due to its technological innovation, comprehensive product lines, and established customer relationships. The industry is characterized by high entry barriers, technical complexity, and increasing domestic substitution of imported equipment.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 691 million, a 20.58% increase year-over-year, but a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 50.3 million, reflecting a 58.12% decline. The company has total assets of approximately RMB 1.88 billion and equity attributable to shareholders of RMB 1.35 billion. Despite profitability challenges, the company is expanding its order book and investing in R&D and market development.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Guangzhou Goaland emphasizes its proprietary liquid cooling technology with high efficiency, reliability, and environmental adaptability. Its products offer superior heat dissipation, energy savings, and extended equipment lifespan, tailored through customized and modular designs. The company’s strong R&D capabilities, extensive patent portfolio, and comprehensive service system provide differentiated value to customers in critical power and data center applications.
